title: FieldReport: one build result returned against one junction
description: Status: co-authored (JinnZ2 + Claude), 2026-11-03. CC0. Only junction_id and outcome are required; everything else is optional so a report fits one SMS or radio line (compact.py). NO personal identifiers: no names, phone numbers, call signs, addresses or exact coordinates. coarse_region is a region a reader could not use to find a household.

junction_version.description: refs.py junction_version of the text built from. Blank = unknown: still raises caution, never counts as a build.

failure_point.description: Plain text: where and how it went wrong.

as_built_vs_specified.description: Substitutions made, e.g. 'tallow for seal oil; cattail down wick'.

soil_water.description: Soil or water condition relevant to the build.
